verses.text: The one scattering has come up before your face; guard the fortress, watch over the road; strengthen your loins, strengthen [your] power greatly!

segments.text: The one scattering has come up before your face; guard the fortress, watch over the road; strengthen your loins, strengthen [your] power greatly!

verses.text: For YHWH will restore the majesty of Jacob, like the majesty of Israel, for those emptying have emptied them and have ruined their branches.

segments.text: For YHWH will restore the majesty of Jacob, like the majesty of Israel, for those emptying have emptied them and have ruined their branches.

verses.text: The shields of his mighty men are red; the men of valor are clothed in scarlet; with fire of burning steel the chariots [come] on the day of his preparing, and the cypresses quiver.

segments.text: The shields of his mighty men are red; the men of valor are clothed in scarlet; with fire of burning steel the chariots [come] on the day of his preparing, and the cypresses quiver.

verses.text: Through the streets the chariots dash; they rush around in the squares; their appearance [is] like torches, like the lightning they run!

segments.text: Through the streets the chariots dash; they rush around in the squares; their appearance [is] like torches, like the lightning they run!

verses.text: He summons his nobles, they stumble in their walk; they hurry [to] her wall, and the siege-cover is prepared.

segments.text: He summons his nobles, they stumble in their walk; they hurry [to] her wall, and the siege-cover is prepared.

verses.text: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

segments.text: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

verses.text: And it is established: She shall be uncovered [and] brought up, and her maidservants will be moaning as the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

segments.text: And it is established: She shall be uncovered [and] brought up, and her maidservants will be moaning as the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

verses.text: And Nineveh [was] like a pool of water, from the days of her, and they flee: “Stand, stand,” and no one is turning back.

segments.text: And Nineveh [was] like a pool of water, from the days of her, and they flee: “Stand, stand,” and no one is turning back.

verses.text: “Plunder the silver, plunder the gold!” And there is no end to the provision—the worth of every precious article.

segments.text: “Plunder the silver, plunder the gold!” And there is no end to the provision—the worth of every precious article.

verses.text: Emptiness, an empty place and laid waste! The heart melts, and the knees shake, and [there is] anguish in all loins, and the faces of all of them are gathered to paleness!

segments.text: Emptiness, an empty place and laid waste! The heart melts, and the knees shake, and [there is] anguish in all loins, and the faces of all of them are gathered to paleness!

verses.text: Where [is] the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place that [was] unto the young lions—where there walked the lion [and] lioness, [and] the cub of the lion, and nothing made them afraid?

segments.text: Where [is] the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place that [was] unto the young lions—where there walked the lion [and] lioness, [and] the cub of the lion, and nothing made them afraid?

verses.text: The lion was tearing enough for his cubs, and strangling for his lionesses; and he filled his caves [with] prey, and his dens with flesh.

segments.text: The lion was tearing enough for his cubs, and strangling for his lionesses; and he filled his caves [with] prey, and his dens with flesh.

verses.text: “Behold, I [am] against you,” a declaration of YHWH of Hosts, “And I will burn in smoke your chariots, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and will be heard no more the voice of your messengers!”
